title: Is your AI lying to customers? Langfuse catches it
description:
Langfuse is an open-source LLM observability platform: a flight recorder for your AI app. It saves every question, answer and step in between as a trace, so when your AI assistant tells a customer the wrong thing, you can see exactly what happened.

In this video:
- What Langfuse is and how tracing works
- 3 real uses: trace a customer complaint, track LLM cost, score answers with user feedback or LLM-as-a-judge
- The catch: licensing and what self-hosting takes
- Who it's for, an alternative, and how to try it in about 5 minutes

Three real uses:
1. Trace a customer complaint back to the exact conversation, prompt and model response
2. Track tokens and cost for every LLM call (prices built in for popular OpenAI, Anthropic and Google models)
3. Score answers with user feedback or LLM-as-a-judge evaluations, so the bad ones rise to the top

The catch: the core is MIT-licensed, but enterprise features in the ee/ folders need a license key. Self-hosting runs a web app, a worker, Postgres, ClickHouse, Redis and S3-compatible storage. Langfuse Cloud has a free tier.

Try it locally:
git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse.git
cd langfuse
docker compose up
(Docker Compose is for local testing; the docs recommend Kubernetes/Helm for production.)

Links:
Repo: https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse

Facts checked 2026-10-20 (Langfuse v4.64.0, about 36k GitHub stars). An open-source option to consider, not an endorsement. Not affiliated with Langfuse or ClickHouse.
